name: @hulala/monorepo
description: Hulala — Growth in motion. A local-first DeepSeek Harness workbench with native Pi, Codex, Claude Code, and DeepSeek Agent Loops.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/runtime build && bun run --cwd apps/harness-web build && bun run --cwd apps/cli build && bun run build:workbench
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/runtime test && bun run --cwd apps/harness-web test && bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd apps/web test && bun run --cwd packages/network-proxy test && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-selector test && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-pi test && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-codex test && bun run --cwd apps/cli test && bun run test:workbench
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/runtime typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/harness-web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/network-proxy typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-selector typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-pi typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-codex typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/agent-loop-claude typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/cli typecheck && bun run typecheck:workbench
scripts.check: bun scripts/workbench/check-boundary.ts && bun run build:vendor && bun run build && bun run test && bun run typecheck
scripts.build:workbench: bun run --cwd apps/local-host build && bun run --cwd apps/workbench build
scripts.test:workbench: bun run --cwd packages/workbench-contracts test && bun run --cwd apps/local-host test && bun run --cwd apps/workbench test && bun test scripts/workbench/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck:workbench: bun run --cwd packages/workbench-contracts typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/plugin-sdk typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/local-host typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/workbench typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/workbench/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:workbench: bun scripts/workbench/check-boundary.ts && bun run --cwd packages/runtime build && bun run --cwd apps/harness-web build:plugins && bun run typecheck:workbench && bun run build:workbench && bun run test:workbench
